falsifier_requirement.trigger: hidden LCA target leaks into visible inputs, N<20, NCBI snapshot or lock hash is missing, residual does not beat comparator, or synonym/version policy is changed after target opening

incumbent_comparator.prediction_rule: Predict the most frequent visible-panel ancestor at the declared rank without reading hidden pairwise lowest-common-ancestor targets.
incumbent_comparator.required_material_margin: lineage replay accuracy and tree-distance residual must beat the rank-only baseline on the same hidden taxon pairs

no_fake_closure_policy: Negative source-bound scoring remains a scientific blocker; it cannot be counted as broad superiority.
pass_predicate: pack_status == PASS, material_margin_met == true, no fail-closed status, replay_record PASS.
repair_strategy: If negative, improve the source-bound model/comparator route from canonical evidence rather than weakening the materiality rule.

residual_requirement.formula: absolute tree-distance between predicted and observed lowest-common-ancestor nodes over hidden taxon pairs
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: mean tree-distance residual must be lower than comparator residual and exact LCA accuracy must be higher than comparator accuracy

residuals.material_margin_rule: source-bound materialized evidence pack must show OC residual strictly below preregistered comparator residual under the declared uncertainty rule

source.source_name: NCBI Taxonomy E-utilities taxonomy lineage records

target_variable.extraction_rule: Hide pairwise lowest-common-ancestor targets until lineage-derived predictions are materialized from locked visible taxon identifiers and permitted lineage prefixes.
target_variable.name: lowest_common_ancestor_tax_id

uncertainty_requirement.rule: Bind the NCBI taxonomy snapshot date, lock hash, and accepted synonym/version policy before target opening.

why_it_failed: Existing executable evidence pack passes strict material superiority predicates.
